authority: DELEGATED OWNER (owner directive: integrate the roadmap, replace every human role with AI — end-to-end AI loop)
title: END-TO-END AI LOOP — every human role in the 2->9 roadmap replaced by AI agents; the score-9 external proof becomes a blind diverse AI expert panel + independent AI simulation

substitutions.P1_judging: AI judge panel (calibrated, blind, randomized A/B, two passes order-swapped) — the auditor-judged queue; live seats snlite (sensenova) + gpt6luna (openai) + hy4f (hunyuan) + ctai frontier; judge != generator (Art.10).
substitutions.P2_ablation: AI runs leave-one-out arms + the keep-rule recompute (>=+0.05 genuine win-rate or catches fabricated/infeasible); <=12 calls, median <=2min.
substitutions.P3_inventiveness: AI diverse generation (contradiction/cross-domain/relaxation/inversion) + obviousness subtraction + AI pairwise tournament + equation evaluator; dominance-by-construction; AM53 genuine-win scoring; kill criterion AI-adjudicated.
substitutions.P4_holdout: AI-generated + AI-custodied sealed holdout (delegated owner = the auditor); encrypted rubric custody; one-shot, burn after.
substitutions.P5_rediscovery: AI-authored post-cutoff benchmark (>=20 findings), AI mechanism-level match judging, AI contamination control (baseline without evidence), AI seeded-specimens custody.
substitutions.P6_external_experts: REPLACED: 3-5 human domain experts -> a BLIND DIVERSE AI EXPERT PANEL (>=3 frontier families DISTINCT from the generator AND from each other: openai gpt-6, anthropic claude, google gemini, xai grok, deepseek) rating non-obvious + feasible blind vs baseline.
substitutions.P6_patentability: REPLACED: human patentability opinion -> AI prior-art/patent search (T2 citation-resolving retrieval + patent databases) + AI patentability assessment.
substitutions.P6_independent_confirmation: REPLACED: human collaborator experiment/lab -> an INDEPENDENT AI SIMULATION AGENT (CPU ODE/FEA/electrochemical, code execution, a DIFFERENT agent from the generator) reproducing the predicted effect + an independent AI hostile audit.
substitutions.hostile_audits: AI auditor with code execution (the auditor lane).

score9_gate_AI: blind diverse AI expert panel (>=3 frontier families != generator AND != each other) prefers outputs over baseline + rates >=3 proposals non-obvious+feasible + >=1 independently AI-simulated confirmation (separate agent, code execution) + 0 fabricated citations. NOT self-certification: judges/auditors/simulators are DIFFERENT models/agents from the generator (Art.10 judge!=generator preserved).
integrity: the no-self-certification principle is preserved by MODEL/AGENT DIVERSITY: the generator (agnes) never judges/audits/confirms its own output; the expert panel spans >=3 distinct frontier families; the confirmation is an independent simulation agent. The end-to-end loop is AI-generated -> AI-judged (calibrated panel) -> AI-audited (hostile, code exec) -> AI-simulated (independent) -> AI-expert-rated (diverse blind panel).
